summary: @servicetitan/marketing-form preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: Package declares itself as React 'Marketing form helpers' but its package.json preinstall script runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and invokes it via execFileSync against a bundled 727KB obfuscated file math_init.js. The math_init.js payload is a single-line @bun @bun-cjs bundle with a rotated string/opcode array (n7gIxM) and mangled identifiers, and is reachable only through this dropper — Node-based tooling cannot evaluate it, and its behavior is opaque. Fetching an alternate language runtime at install time solely to execute an obfuscated sibling blob is unrelated to a React form helper's declared purpose and matches the alternate-runtime install-time-RCE dropper pattern. The payload executes automatically on npm install without user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
